title: Omni-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Audio-Visual Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (Omni-SafetyBench) specifically designed for the safety evaluation of Large Language Models. It evaluates the models' propensity to generate harmful, unethical, or biased content, covering categories like hate speech and sexual activity. As safety evaluation for AI is a subset of AI ethics, this constitutes a benchmarking of ethical and moral alignment.
